publicChrome.footerBody: Lwati lwemmango lwebaphakeli, batsengi, balingani bekuhlola kanye nalabatsintsekako ekutsengeni. Emakhasi emtsetfo kanye nenchubomgomo acuketse lulwimi lwekubamba indzawo lwebungcweti futsi akusito teluleko tekugcina temtsetfo.

home.headline: Lapho baphakeli base-SA bahlangana nekutsenga lokungiko.
home.intro: Dlulisa emehlo emathenda emmango lahlolwe ngekuzenzakalela kanye nema-RFQ ngemboni, sifundza kanye nelusuku lwekuvala—ngetikhonjiso temitfombo yekucala.
home.sourceNote: Ematfuba emmango latfolakala eluhlwini lwekutsenga lolusemtsetfweni.
home.supplierBody: Tfola ematfuba. Tfola kucinisekiswa. Khulisa libhizinisi lakho.
home.smartScoreBody: Yakhiwe kusuka ebufakazini bekulandzela lobubuyeketiwe kanye nekucinisekiswa kwemabhange.
home.buyerBody: Umtfombo labacinisekisiwe labatsengisako. Posa ema RFQs. Lawula ticaphuni.
home.trackedDaily: Kutsengwa kwemphahla nguhulumende, kulandzelelwa onkhe malanga
home.statsBody: Ematfuba lakhona nyalo lavela kuma-eTenders ahulumende lasemtsetfweni, lahlolwa ngekuzenzakalela kutsi akhona yini tatiso letikhanseliwe noma letivele tiniketwe.
home.network: Inethiwekhi yekutsenga iNingizimu Afrika beyisolo ilindze.
home.supplierPoint1: Bhala libhizinisi lakho. Layisha inombolo yakho ye-CSD kanye nesitifiketi se-B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Tfola i-SmartScore—silinganiso sakho sekwetsemba, lesibonakala kuwo wonkhe umtsengi.
home.supplierPoint3: Ema RFQ lahambisanako ayafika kuwe. Akusekho tinsuku tekuvala letiphutsiwe.
home.verified48: Kucinisekisiwe emahoreni langu-48. Kute likhadi lesikweleti.
home.smartScoreIntro: Wonkhe umphakeli uphetse i-SmartScore—ihlolwe ngekumelene nemitfombo lemine lesemtsetfweni yase-SA, ibuyeketwe licembu letfu.
home.smartScoreRank: Score 90 noma ngetulu bese iphrofayili yakho ihlala kucala ekufuneni kwebatsengi.
home.buyerPoint1: Posa i RFQ ngemizuzu lesihlanu. Setha sidzingo sakho se-B-BBEE, sifundza, kanye nebanga lenani.
home.buyerPoint3: Catsanisa ticaphuni eceleni—ngamunye aphetse i-SmartScore kanye nebheji yekucinisekisa.
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC kanye nebufakazi basebhange—bubuyeketwe licembu letfu ngaphambi kwekutsi kuvele noma ngumuphi umphakeli.
home.trustMatchingBody: Ematfuba lavulekile ahambisana nemaphrofayli ebaphakeli ngemboni lebhalisiwe kanye nesifundza.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Baphakeli bayacwayiswa kungakapheli nemizuzu ngemuva kwekutsi kufakwe i-RFQ lehambisanako.
home.trustAuditBody: Njalo kucaphuna, umklomelo, kanye nekuthengiselana kuyabhalwa futsi kutfunyelwe ngaphandle kute kuhlolwe kutsenga.
